async def act(page):
    # Set the filter parameters to get monthly order counts for 2022
    # Set Period to 'Month'
    period_combobox = page.get_by_role('group', name='Filter').get_by_role('combobox', name='Period')
    await period_combobox.select_option('Month')
    
    # Set From date to Jan 1, 2022
    from_textbox = page.get_by_role('group', name='Filter').get_by_role('textbox', name='From *')
    await from_textbox.fill('01/01/2022')
    
    # Set To date to Dec 31, 2022
    to_textbox = page.get_by_role('group', name='Filter').get_by_role('textbox', name='To *')
    await to_textbox.fill('12/31/2022')
    
    # Set Order Status to 'Specified' (assuming it will show successful orders)
    order_status_combobox = page.get_by_role('group', name='Filter').get_by_role('combobox', name='Order Status')
    await order_status_combobox.select_option('Specified')
    
    # Set Empty Rows to 'No'
    empty_rows_combobox = page.get_by_role('group', name='Filter').get_by_role('combobox', name='Empty Rows')
    await empty_rows_combobox.select_option('No')
    
    # Set Show Actual Values to 'Yes'
    actual_values_combobox = page.get_by_role('group', name='Filter').get_by_role('combobox', name='Show Actual Values')
    await actual_values_combobox.select_option('Yes')
    
    # Click 'Show Report' button to generate the report
    show_report_button = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('button', name='Show Report')
    await show_report_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the report to load; use networkidle to ensure all data is fetched
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Now extract the monthly counts from the report table
    # Wait for a table role to appear after the report is generated
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Brief wait for UI update
    table = page.get_by_role('table').first
    rows = table.get_by_role('row')
    
    # Initialize a dictionary to store monthly counts
    monthly_counts = {}
    
    # Iterate through rows, skipping header if necessary
    row_count = await rows.count()
    for i in range(row_count):
        row = rows.nth(i)
        cells = row.get_by_role('cell')
        cell_count = await cells.count()
        if cell_count >= 2:  # Assuming at least two columns: month and count
            month_cell = cells.nth(0)
            count_cell = cells.nth(1)
            month_text = await month_cell.text_content()
            count_text = await count_cell.text_content()
            if month_text and count_text and month_text.strip() and count_text.strip():
                # Clean up text and store
                month = month_text.strip()
                count_val = count_text.strip()
                monthly_counts[month] = count_val
    
    # Format the result as MM:COUNT for Jan to Dec 2022
    months_order = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
    result_lines = []
    for month in months_order:
        if month in monthly_counts:
            result_lines.append(f'{month}:{monthly_counts[month]}')
        else:
            # If month not found, use '0' to include all months
            result_lines.append(f'{month}:0')
    
    # Join with newlines for readability
    result = '\n'.join(result_lines)
    
    # Return the result as terminate_with_result
    return result
